description: This file contains a PHP class implementing a repository for leads using PDO for database interactions. It provides methods to save lead data into a database table, with support for configuring the table name via environment variables.

classes.name: PdoLeadRepository
classes.description: A final class implementing lead persistence using PDO for database access. It offers a save method to insert lead data and retrieve the new record's ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the PDO instance used for database operations.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Inserts a lead record into the database and returns its ID as a string. Throws an exception if no ID is returned after insertion.
